changes_made.explanation: Added a more comprehensive description of the outputs to better capture the conversational nature of the system. The paper generates conversational actions (questions and recommendations) in multi-turn dialogues.
Removed duplicate entries for SR and AT. The paper uses three main automatic metrics: Success Rate (SR), Average Turn (AT), and hDCG (hierarchical Discounted Cumulative Gain).
No LLMs are used as judges/evaluators in this paper. The evaluation is conducted using simulated users and automatic metrics.
No human evaluation is conducted in this paper. The paper explicitly states that training and evaluation are carried out through conversations with a user simulator.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on conversational recommender systems with natural language dialogue generation. It evaluates using simulated users and automatic metrics (SR, AT, hDCG) rather than human evaluation or LLM-as-judge approaches. The extraction was generally accurate, with minor cleanup needed for duplicate metric entries.
